blocks.text: Rachal is a Registered Nurse with over 20 years’ experience as a home health care case manager. She knows what it takes to provide hands-on patient care within a patient’s home, coordinate the services of other physicians or health care providers, communicate with health insurance providers, and supervise other nurses who visit the home.

Rachal finds pleasure in helping people understand transitional care needs with ease and less stress by helping patients and families during times of change due to age related health concerns. Her goal is to protect individuals and families from healthcare despair by advocating for patient rights. She believes that the safety and quality of life of our loved ones is paramount during this crucial period of life. Rachal’s expertise and knowledge of the healthcare industry offers endless possibilities to help everyone who seeks her advice.

Rachal has a contagious smile and makes every effort to make others feel the passion and joy that shines through with her genuine nature. Rachal beautifully displays hands of the heart to all she engages with, she wants to help the community with transitional ease when life events warrant an evaluation of individuals quality of life.
